import json,cv2
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from workspace.vision.tiles_runtime_v0_2.template_preprocess_ab import baseline_feature,_load_crop
from workspace.vision.tiles_runtime_v0_2.gold_score_calibration import training_labels
root=Path('dataset/tiles_runtime_v0_2');labels,lineage=training_labels(root,'references/vision/2026-10-01/concealed_template_match_lineage.development.json',{r['image'] for r in json.load(open('references/vision/2026-10-24/sampled_classifier_crop_review_v0_1.json'))['excluded_training_images']},{'reviewed_match_2026_09_26_eight_hand','reviewed_match_2026_10_12_room324504'})
labels=[r for r in labels if r['region'] in ('hand_region','draw_visual','draw_region') and not r.get('gold_skin_only')]
def group(r):return 'match:'+lineage[r['sha256']].match_group if r['sha256'] in lineage else 'unresolved-sha:'+r['sha256']
features=[baseline_feature(_load_crop(root,r)) for r in labels];results=[]
for i,r in enumerate(labels):
 bank=[(t['tile_id'],features[j]) for j,t in enumerate(labels) if group(t)!=group(r)]
 for shifted in [False,True]:
  q=cv2.copyMakeBorder(features[i],3,3,3,3,cv2.BORDER_REPLICATE) if shifted else features[i]
  score,pred=max((float(cv2.matchTemplate(q,f,cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED).max()),t) for t,f in bank)
  results.append(dict(image=r['image'],truth=r['tile_id'],group=group(r),candidate=pred,score=score,mode='shift3' if shifted else 'baseline',true_class_in_bank=r['tile_id'] in {t for t,_ in bank}))
for mode in ('baseline','shift3'):
 rows=[r for r in results if r['mode']==mode];print(mode,len(rows),sum(r['candidate']==r['truth'] for r in rows),sum(r['score']>=.82 for r in rows),[r for r in rows if r['score']>=.82 and r['candidate']!=r['truth']],flush=True)
Path('../hand_alignment_crossgroup_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
